semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Oriole Networks focuses on photonic networking technologies that enhance data center performance, which indirectly supports semiconductor applications in AI and HPC.
summary: Oriole Networks is a photonic networking company that develops innovative technologies aimed at transforming data center networking for AI and high-performance computing. Their flagship product, PRISM, utilizes a pure photonic network to improve data transmission efficiency and reduce energy consumption, addressing challenges in traditional electronic switching.
capabilities: Deterministic optical fabric for data centers

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Oriole recently deployed its technology in the UK ARIA Scaling Inference Lab in collaboration with AMD.
